text: I've been sitting on the last line since the note came in. Too bad for me, but for him he's free. That's not a punchline. That's a thesis. The slow lander isn't slow. He's the only one on deck who isn't racing anything.
And you're going to sing it plain.
The word as witness. No bending the note. The truth doesn't need a bend. It needs to be written down.
